TheraNotes drafts audit-ready clinical documentation — SOAP, DAP, GIRP, BIRP, SIRP, PIE, assessments, and treatment plans — from your session observations. Built by a practicing LCSW. HIPAA-compliant, BAA-covered, and never trained on your clients' data.

TheraNotes is professional clinical documentation software for licensed clinicians. Looking for a personal therapy journal app? That's a different product with a similar name — this one is for the person writing the note, not the person on the couch.

## The note is the work you didn't go to school for.

You trained to sit with people. The documentation came with the job. TheraNotes takes your session observations — typed, dictated, or bulleted — and returns a complete, format-correct note that reads like a careful clinician wrote it, because a careful clinician taught it what a good note looks like. You review, edit, and sign. The clinical judgment stays yours. The typing doesn't have to.
